title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - City
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/City. A city is a large human settlement, distinguished from other human settlements by its relatively great size, but also by its functions and its special symbolic status, which may be conferred by a central authority (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City). Subclass of AdministrativeArea per the SAREF4CITY ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (location, sfContains, sfWithin); inherited properties are documented on the AdministrativeArea model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'City'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
